notablePrerequisites: There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out with haste.
Declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
Fear of Missing Out triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
